title: SvgFeTurbulence
responsibility: Renders the native feTurbulence element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeTurbulence.children
inputs.description: Optional Snippet whose rendered output becomes the content of the feTurbulence element; it matters only when the caller needs content inside the element, and when it is omitted nothing is rendered in its place. The component passes that output straight into the element without validating or filtering it.

outputs.name: SvgFeTurbulence
outputs.description: The feTurbulence element itself, created in the SVG namespace with the fixed tag name feTurbulence, with every forwarded attribute and the optional children applied directly to it and no wrapper element around it. The component sets no attributes of its own, so only the attributes the caller passes appear on the element.
